title: Bildad Speaks: The Wicked Are Punished

questions.question: Who answers Job in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Job 18:1 (ESV): "Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:"

questions.question: Why are we counted as what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:3 (ESV): "Why are we counted as cattle? Why are we stupid in your sight?"

questions.question: You who tear yourself in your what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:4 (ESV): "You who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you..."

questions.question: The light of the wicked is what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:5 (ESV): "Indeed, the light of the wicked is put out, and the flame of his fire does not shine."

questions.question: Terrors frighten him on every what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:11 (ESV): "Terrors frighten him on every side, and chase him at his heels."

questions.question: For he is cast into a what by his own feet?
questions.explanation: Job 18:8 (ESV): "For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walks on its mesh."

questions.question: His strong steps are shortened, and his own schemes do what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:7 (ESV): "His strong steps are shortened, and his own schemes throw him down."

questions.question: His memory perishes from the what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:17 (ESV): "His memory perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the street."

questions.question: He has no offspring or descendant among his people, and no survivor where?
questions.explanation: Job 18:19 (ESV): "He has no offspring or descendant among his people, and no survivor where he used to live."

questions.question: Surely such are the dwellings of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:21 (ESV): "Surely such are the dwellings of the ungodly, such is the place of him who knows not God."

questions.question: His roots dry up beneath, and his branches wither where?
questions.explanation: Job 18:16 (ESV): "His roots dry up beneath, and his branches wither above."

questions.question: He is thrust from light into darkness, and driven out of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:18 (ESV): "He is thrust from light into darkness, and driven out of the world."

questions.question: They of the west are appalled at his day, and horror seizes whom?
questions.explanation: Job 18:20 (ESV): "They of the west are appalled at his day, and horror seizes them of the east."

questions.question: Disease devours his skin; the firstborn of death devours his what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:13 (ESV): "It devours the parts of his skin; the firstborn of death devours his limbs."

questions.question: He is torn from the tent in which he trusted and is brought to the king of what?
questions.explanation: Job 18:14 (ESV): "He is torn from the tent in which he trusted and is brought to the king of terrors."

key_verse_text: Indeed, the light of the wicked is put out, and the flame of his fire does not shine.
